mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ha_artifact ( owner_key, artifact_id, kind, status, title, media_type, content_ref, size_bytes, checksum_sha256, parent_artifact_id, source, source_ref, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, version ) VALUES ( #{ownerKey}, #{artifactId}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{title}, #{mediaType}, #{contentRef}, #{sizeBytes}, #{checksumSha256}, #{parentArtifactId}, #{source}, #{sourceRef}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{deletedAt}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ha_artifact WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND artifact_id = #{artifactId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ha_artifact SET kind = #{kind}, status = #{status}, title = #{title}, media_type = #{mediaType}, content_ref = #{contentRef}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, checksum_sha256 = #{checksumSha256}, parent_artifact_id = #{parentArtifactId}, source = #{source}, source_ref = #{sourceRef}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND artifact_id = #{artifactId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ha_conversation_history ( owner_key, session_id, turn_id, record_type, record_id, artifact_id, artifact_role, payload_json, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerKey}, #{sessionId}, #{turnId}, 'ARTIFACT_REFERENCE', #{recordId}, #{artifactId}, #{artifactRole}, #{payloadJson}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ha_conversation_history WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND record_type = 'ARTIFACT_REFERENCE' AND record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT history_sequence, record_id, payload_json FROM ha_conversation_history WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND turn_id = #{turnId} AND record_type = 'MESSAGE' ORDER BY history_sequence
SELECT payload_json FROM ha_conversation_history WHERE history_sequence = #{historySequence} AND owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND record_type = 'MESSAGE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ha_conversation_history WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND artifact_id = #{artifactId} AND record_type = 'ARTIFACT_REFERENCE' ORDER BY created_at, record_id
